name: parse_skill

test_list.description: Parse bounded YAML front matter and preserve body bytes including CRLF.
Reject schema drift, unsafe identifiers, duplicate tools, and path traversal.
Enforce required front matter and source size bounds before context loading.
Allow external URL references without treating them as local files.
Keep the bundled skill fixtures parseable.

inputs.name: src
inputs.description: UTF-8 SKILL.md bytes with YAML front matter.

output_description: Validated metadata, exact body text, and bounded content digests.
